records.name: res.country.state.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <list string="State" editable="bottom">
                    <field name="name"/>
                    <field name="code"/>
                    <field name="country_id" options="{'no_create': True, 'no_open': True}"/>
                </list>
            </field>

records.name: res.country.state.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <form string="State">
                    <sheet>
                        <group>
                            <field name="name"/>
                            <field name="code"/>
                            <field name="country_id" options="{"no_open": True, "no_create": True}"/>
                        </group>
                    </sheet>
                </form>
            </field>

records.name: res.country.state.search
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <search string="Country">
                    <field name="name"/>
                    <field name="country_id"/>
                    <group>
                        <filter name="groupby_country" string="Country" context="{'group_by': 'country_id'}"/>
                    </group>
                </search>
            </field>

records.name: l10n.in.res.country.state.form.inhert
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <field name="code" position="after">
                <field name="l10n_in_tin" invisible="country_id != %(base.in)d"/>
            </field>
        </field>

records.name: l10n.in.res.country.state.list.inhert
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <field name="code" position="after">
                <field name="l10n_in_tin" groups="base.group_no_one"/>
            </field>
        </field>
